archetypes.name: Pride of the Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Veteran Squads and Terminator Squads (Saturnine, Cataphractii and Indomitus) can be taken as Troops.
- Only a single Heavy Support choice and a single Fast Attack choice can be taken.
- The army cannot include more units that are not Infantry than units that are Infantry.
- The army cannot include Fortifications.
- Allied Detachments: factions that are Battle Brothers count as Allies of Convenience, Allies of Convenience stay as they are, and Desperate Allies cannot be taken.

archetypes.name: Armoured Spearhead
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Predators can be taken as Troops.
- Legion Sicaran Battle Tanks can be taken as Elites.
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Land Raider Carrier instead if it has ten models or fewer.
- Infantry units must start the game as passengers inside a transport.

archetypes.name: Drop Pod Assault (HH)
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino or a Land Raider Carrier may take a Legion Drop Pod instead.
- A unit with a Legion Drop Pod must arrive by Deep Strike.
- Units without a Drop Pod must start the game in Reserve and cannot arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Recon Demi-Company
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Scout Squads and Seeker Squads can be taken as Troops.
- All compulsory Troops selections must be Legion Scout Squads.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Angel's Wrath
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Caestus Assault Ram instead.
- A Flyer transport in reserve may enter automatically in the first battle round.
- Infantry units without jump packs must start the game as passengers inside a Flyer transport.
- Infantry units with jump packs must start the game in Reserve (they can arrive by Deep Strike).
- The army cannot include vehicles without the Flyer type, and cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Sky-hunter Phalanx
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Sky-hunter Squadrons and Land Speeder Squadrons can be taken as Troops.
- Vehicles in the army must be Fast, Skimmers or Flyers.
- Infantry units must start the game as passengers inside a Flyer transport.
- The army cannot include Dreadnoughts or Fortifications.
- Allied Detachments: factions that are Battle Brothers count as Allies of Convenience, Allies of Convenience stay as they are, and Desperate Allies cannot be taken.

archetypes.name: Underworld Assault
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Legion Termite instead.
- Legion Termites can be taken as Fast Attack and Heavy Support choices.
- Infantry units without the Massive(X) ability must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Termite.
- Units that are not Legion Termites or passengers in one cannot start in Reserve and cannot arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Fury of the Ancients
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Contemptor Dreadnoughts can be taken as Troops, and all of the army's Troops selections must be Contemptor Dreadnoughts.
- Only a single Fast Attack choice and a single Heavy Support choice that is not made of Dreadnoughts can be taken.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Legion Specialists
archetypes.desc:
- Techmarines and Apothecaries gain the Advisor ability (for each HQ selection, one copy of each may be taken without occupying an AOP slot) and the Command squad ability (they can join any unit), but cannot be promoted to a Forge Lord or a Primus Medicae.
- The army has access to the Primarch of the chosen Legacy (if it has one).

archetypes.name: Alpha Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Hydra.
- The army has access to the Primarch Alpharius.
- Every unit starts the game in Reserve and may arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank. Up to three units may start deployed on the battlefield instead.
- A unit that arrives from Reserve gains +1 to hit with all its attacks in the battle round it arrives.

archetypes.name: Iron Warriors
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lord of Iron.
- The army has access to the Primarch Perturabo.
- The army may select the Iron Circle Maniple, which cannot be selected without this archetype.
- The army must include Perturabo, a Warsmith or a Centurion with the Siegebreaker Consul.
- Shrapnel bolters and Shrapnel pistols gain +1 shot (not the Shrapnel cannon).
- Warsmith, Iron Havocs and Tyrant Siege Terminators: see the options of the Praetor, the Legion Heavy Support Squad and the Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad.

archetypes.name: Emperor's Children
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Phoenician.
- The army has access to the Primarch Fulgrim.
- The army may select the Kakophoni Squad and the Palatine Blade Squad, which cannot be selected without this archetype.
- Kakophoni Squads can be taken as Troops.
- Up to four units (not Heavy or Slow) gain Outflank. Deployed units gain +1" Movement; at most half of the units can start in reserve.
- The army must include a Legion Champion.
- Phoenix power weapons: a character or Sergeant may swap a Power sword for a Phoenix rapier for -1 point or for a Phoenix power spear for +1 point.
- Phoenix Terminators: the Indomitus Terminator Squad can take the options on its sheet (Phoenix power spear -20 points, +1" Movement and WS 2+ +2 points each, Skill Unmatched +5 points).

archetypes.name: Terror Assault (Night Lords)
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Night Haunter.
- The army has access to the Primarch Konrad Curze.
- Legion Veteran Squads can be taken as Troops, and all of the army's Troops selections must be Legion Veteran Squads.

archetypes.name: The Swift Blade (Night Lords)
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Night Haunter.
- The army has access to the Primarch Konrad Curze.
- Legion Outrider Squadrons can be taken as Troops.
- No Heavy Support choices.

archetypes.name: World Eaters
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lord of Red Sands.
- The army has access to the Primarch Angron.
- The army may select the Rampager Squad, which cannot be selected without this archetype.
- Rampager Squads can be taken as Troops.
- Only one Heavy Support selection can be taken.
- All units of the army have the Legion: World Eaters (WE).
- Savage Fervour: an Astartes chainsword may become a Chainaxe for +1 point.
- Red Butchers: the Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad can swap its Combi-bolter and Power sword for a Twin power axe (-7 points each).
- Blind Rage: any unit may gain the Blind Rage ability for +10 points.
- Butcher's Nails: a psyker suffers "Perils of the Warp" on any double when it tries to manifest a power, and applies both Perils results.

archetypes.name: Word Bearers
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Archtraitor.
- The army has access to the Primarch Lorgar.
- All units of the army have the Legion: Word Bearers (WB).
- Unwavering Conviction: if at least one model of the army takes part in a melee, its side gets +1 to its combat resolution.
- Centurion Command Squads equipped with the Gal Vorbak possession can be taken as Troops.
- Dark Brethren and Ashen Circle: see the options of the Centurion Command Squad and the Legion Assault Squad.
- Glorious Martyrdom: once per battle, when an enemy unit makes a ranged attack against a friendly Legion: Word Bearers unit, choose one model of the target unit: all the wounds of that attack are allocated to it, and if it is removed as a casualty the rest of the wounds of that attack are discarded.
- Diabolist: a Centurion may take the Diabolist Consul.

archetypes.name: Death Guard
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Death Lord.
- The army has access to the Primarch Mortarion.
- The army may select the Deathshroud Terminator Squad, which cannot be selected without this archetype.
- All units of the army have the Legion: Death Guard (DG).
- Units with the Legion: Death Guard automatically pass Dangerous Terrain tests.
- Units cannot be given an Advance order and cannot arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank (Charge orders are allowed).
- Grave Wardens: the Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad can take the options on its sheet (Assault grenade launcher +19 points each, Heavy alchem flamer +1 point per 5 models, Plague carrier +15 points).
- Alchem munitions: a Hand flamer may become an Alchem pistol for -2 points, a Flamer an Alchem flamer for +14 points, a Heavy flamer a Heavy alchem flamer for +12 points and a Flamestorm cannon an Alchem cannon for -26 points; a combi-weapon may take the Alchem combi-flamer as secondary weapon.
- Power scythe: a character or Sergeant may swap a Power sword for it for +6 points.
- Mortarion's Edict: every psyker in the army suffers -1 to manifest a psychic power.

archetypes.name: Sons of Horus
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Warmaster.
- The army has access to the Primarch Horus Lupercal.
- Legion Terminator Squads (Saturnine, Cataphractii and Indomitus) can be taken as Troops.
- Legion Assault Squads can be taken as Troops.
- Infantry and Dreadnought units gain +1" Movement.

archetypes.name: Thousand Sons
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Crimson King.
- The army has access to the Primarch Magnus the Red.
- The army may select the Castellax-Achea Automata, which cannot be selected without this archetype; they can be taken as Troops, with at least two models.
- Flesh Change: a unit that is not a character ignores Perils of the Warp. Instead, on any double in a psychic test roll 1D6 and apply the result until the end of its next activation: 1 +2" Movement, 2 +1 Strength, 3 +1 Toughness, 4 +1 Initiative, 5 +1 Wound, 6 +1 Attack. The third time the same result comes up for that unit, one model is removed, a Chaos Spawn is placed within 3" of it and the unit suffers 1D6 automatic hits (Strength 4, AP 0, Damage 1).
- Castellax-Achea: Psi-locus range 24" and Aegis(3+); Objective secured! only within 6" of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker (not a Psy-automata).
- Up to six units made up entirely of Infantry gain Deep strike and, the turn they arrive, Terrifying(-1).
- Asphyx: a Bolt pistol, a Bolter (also the one of a combi-weapon) and a Combi-bolter may become Asphyx versions for +2, +1 and +1 points.
- Aether-fire: a Plasma pistol may become an Aether-fire pistol for -7 points, a Plasma blaster an Aether-fire blaster for -13 points and a Plasma cannon an Aether-fire cannon for -6 points.
- Achea force weapons: characters and Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squads may swap a Power sword for an Achea force sword for +1 point, an Achea force axe for +0 points or an Achea force maul for +1 point.
- Gravis force blade: a Contemptor Dreadnought may swap its close combat weapon for it for -1 point.
- Khenetai and Ammitara: see the options of the Legion Veteran Squad and the Seeker Squad.

legacies.name: Legacy of the Hydra
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Alpha Legion Armory.
Legion: Alpha Legion (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Iron
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Iron Warriors Armory.
Legion: Iron Warriors (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Night Haunter
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Night Lords Armory.
Legion: Night Lords (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Archtraitor
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Word Bearers Armory.
Legion: Word Bearers (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Warmaster
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Sons of Horus Armory.
- Any model in a Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad may swap their Combi-bolter for a Banestrike combi-bolter for +3 points each, and their Power sword for a Carsoran power axe for +0 points or a Carsoran power tabar for +1 point each.
Legion: Sons of Horus (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Red Sands
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the World Eaters Armory.
The army may have one additional Elite selection per AOP, which can only be used for Rampager Squads.
Legion: World Eaters (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Death Lord
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Death Guard Armory.
Legion: Death Guard (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Phoenician
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Emperor's Children Armory.
Legion: Emperor's Children (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Crimson King
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Thousand Sons Armory.
Legion: Thousand Sons (Traitor).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Sundered
legacies.desc:
The army has access to one Legion-specific unit or Consul type per 1000 points of game size.
Armory: only the general Armory (the Blackshields have no Legion Armory of their own).

traits.name: Flawless Execution
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order, it gains +1 Initiative and may re-roll melee to hit rolls of 1 until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: To The Bitter End
traits.desc: When the unit would flee, it may choose to become pinned instead.

traits.name: Siege Experts
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Sunder(1)" ability for all ranged attacks.

traits.name: Horrors of the Night
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 to hit and +1 to wound in melee against units with at least one Battleshock token or if the enemy unit is outnumbered. When determining if a unit is outnumbered, models with the "Massive(X) special rule count as a number of models equal to 1 + the value included as part of that special rule. Models with the Vehicle Unit Type count as a number of models equal to 3 x their hull points.

traits.name: Bloody Murder
traits.desc: All melee attacks of the unit gain the "Gruesome" ability. The unit itself gains the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.

traits.name: The Butcher's Nails
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Berserk(5+)" ability. At the end of each activation, roll a D6 for each unit with this rule that is not engaged in close combat. For each 1, remove one model from the unit. Only for creature units.

traits.name: Bloodlust
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Blind Rage" ability.

traits.name: Remorseless and Intractable
traits.desc: At the beginning of its activation, the unit may choose to gain the "Unyielding" ability until its next activation.

traits.name: Sons of Barbarus
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Move through cover" ability.

traits.name: Cult Arcana
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Psyker" ability and can cast 1 psychic power per battle round. It knows both powers from one Prosperine Cult discipline. Additionally, the unit gains the "Brotherhood of Psykers" ability.

traits.name: Signs and Portents
traits.desc: If the unit or an attached Character suffer Perils of the Warp, the unit gains one Battleshock token.

traits.name: Merciless Fighters
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 attack in melee against units with at least one Battleshock token or if the enemy unit is outnumbered. When determining if a unit is outnumbered, models with the "Massive(X) special rule count as a number of models equal to 1 + the value included as part of that special rule. Models with the Vehicle Unit Type count as a number of models equal to 3 x their hull points. Additionally, Vehicles gain an additional +3 automatic hits when performing a Tank Shock.

traits.name: Death Dealers
traits.desc: If the unit is making a ranged attack against targets within 12", it gains +1 to ranged to wound rolls.

traits.name: True Believers
traits.desc: The unit may re-roll failed Leadership tests.

traits.name: Cut Them Down
traits.desc: The unit gains +1d3 to its combat resolution in melee (not cumulative between multiple units), and may roll 2d6 to pursue fleeing units.

traits.name: Mutable Tactics
traits.desc: Each creature unit may select one Veteran ability, or gain an additional one if it already has access to them.

traits.name: Lies and Obfuscation
traits.desc: The unit gains the benefit of light cover until its first activation.

special_traits.name: Blackshields
special_traits.desc: Two traits chosen in combination from the Space Marines and Chaos Space Marines codexes may be chosen and taken by all units in the army.
